## About
We're a collision repair shop on Bixby Drive in City of Industry. When your car comes in after an accident, we handle the work from the frame out: straightening, panel and dent repair, mechanical fixes, alignment and paint.
We also know the paperwork side can be the hardest part. We help report insurance claims, explain your estimate, keep you posted on repair status and set up a rental car so you can keep your day moving.
Our customers rate us 4.4 from 40 Google reviews. Stop by or give us a call and we'll walk you through what your car needs.

## Services
- Vehicle frame straightening: Major collisions can skew a frame. We use an OEM specification frame machine and computerized systems to bring damaged frames back to their original specs.
- Major body work and dentless repair: Our technicians section and replace panels and rails, recondition bumpers and wheels, and handle extensive dent pulling.
- Mechanical repair and wheel alignment: When an accident does more than cosmetic damage, we handle alignment diagnosis, suspension parts, sub-frame adjustments and engine components.
- Glasurit paint: We paint with Glasurit for a durable finish, a close color match and a car that looks like the day you bought it.
- Insurance claim help: We walk you through the claim process, help report your claim and handle rental expenses with your insurer.
- End-of-lease returns: Small scratches can lead to dealer penalties. We spot paint and fix minor scratches before your leased car goes back to the dealer.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. You're welcome to walk in, or you can call and schedule a time.

Q: Can you help me get a rental car while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. We work with Enterprise, Hertz and other major rental companies to help you get a good rate.

Q: Can you help with towing and filing my claim?
A: Yes. We can help with towing, reporting a new insurance claim and explaining your estimate.

Q: Do you have another location?
A: Yes. Along with our City of Industry shop on Bixby Drive, we have a location in Rowland Heights.
